CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. Class A Buy Ratings Rise
: Analysts kept bullish on CrowdStrike (CRWD) with multiple maintained Buy/Outperform ratings and price target moves: targets range roughly $220–$300, several firms raised targets this cycle.
CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. Class A Falcon IQ Launch
: CrowdStrike (CRWD) launched Falcon IQ, using OpenAI, Anthropic and NVIDIA models; it automates assessment, prioritization and remediation with 50+ no-code agents and a partner dashboard.
CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. Class A EY Partnership
: CrowdStrike (CRWD) chosen by EY to integrate Falcon into EY.ai Value Blueprints, extending QuiltWorks to add Falcon security across identities, cloud, data and AI workloads for enterprise AI.
CRWD Aided Law Enforcement Disrupt Sality
: CRWD aided law enforcement to disrupt the Sality botnet. Investigators found EggJagger clipboard malware replacing crypto addresses, linked to ~15,000 infected devices and ~€1.5M peak stolen funds.
